questions.text: A binary operation * is defined on the set X = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} as a*b = ab + a + b. Compute 1 * 3
questions.explanation: Using the definition of the binary operation and identity element e = 0: a * a^(-1) = e ⇒ 2*(a^(-1)) + 2 + a^(-1) = 0 ⇒ 3a^(-1) = -2 ⇒ a^(-1) = -2/3. Therefore, 7 is the correct inverse.
